verdict.rationale: xAI maintains a dedicated release-notes page (grok-docs-1) documenting new model launches like grok-4.7, plus dated migration/retirement guides with explicit deprecation timelines and auto-redirect behavior (grok-supp-deprecation, grok-docs-19), and a documented model-alias versioning scheme (grok-supp-aliases) that clarifies how model IDs evolve over time.
